sloka: किं नु तस्य मया कार्य्यं दुर्जातेन महात्मन: ।यो मृतो मम शोकेन मया चापि न संस्कृत: ॥ २.१०२.९॥
transliteration: kiṁ nu tasya mayā kāryyaṁ durjātena mahātmana: ।yo mṛto mama śokena mayā cāpi na saṁskṛta: ॥ 2.102.9॥

translations.english: I could not even perform the last rites of that magnanimous one who died of grief on account of me. What use is my life with an unlucky birth?
